      "source": [
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import sklearn\n",
        "from sklearn.datasets import make_blobs\n",
        "from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsClassifier\n",
        "from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split\n",
        "from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "# generate dataset\n",
        "X,y = make_blobs(n_samples=4000, centers=3, cluster_std=2, random_state=80)\n",
        "print('X(features):')\n",
        "print(X)\n",
        "print('\\n shape of X:')\n",
        "print(X.shape)\n",
        "print('\\n y(Target/class):')\n",
        "print(y)\n",
        "print('\\n shape of y:')\n",
        "print(y.shape)\n",
        "# plots\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(6,6))\n",
        "plt.xlabel('Feature 1')\n",
        "plt.ylabel('Feature 2')\n",
        "plt.scatter(X[:, 0], X[:, 1], c=y, cmap='rainbow')\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "df = pd.DataFrame(X)\n",
        "df.head()\n",
        "plt.rcParams['figure.figsize'] = (10, 15)\n",
        "df.plot(kind='hist', bins = 100, subplots=True, layout=(5,2), sharex=False, sharey=False)\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "#scatter plot answer-how are my classes distributed based on feature 1 and feature 2?\n",
        "# histogram -- distribution of each feature individually\n",
        "# the first step is to figure out the k . the calculation of the k value varies greatly depending on the situation\n",
        "#the defualt value of k when using the scikit-learn library is 5 and the default distance metric used is euclidean\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "# tuning the model to get high k nearest neighbor accuracy\n",
        "from sklearn.model_selection import GridSearchCV\n",
        "para_grid = {'n_neighbors': np.arange(1,4)}\n",
        "knn = KNeighborsClassifier()\n",
        "knn_cv = GridSearchCV(knn, para_grid, cv=5)\n",
        "knn_cv.fit(X,y)\n",
        "print(knn_cv.best_params_)\n",
        "print(knn_cv.best_score_)\n",
        "# train and test split\n",
        "X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.3, random_state=42)\n",
        "# instantiate the model\n",
        "knn = KNeighborsClassifier(n_neighbors=3)\n",
        "# fit the model to the training set\n",
        "knn.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
        "# make predictions\n",
        "y_pred = knn.predict(X_test)\n",
        "print('model accuracy score : {0:0.4f}' . format(accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred)))"
      ]
    }
  ]
